common: SINGLE-ROOM INTERIOR ONLY. Each scene contains exactly one rectangular room_shell with exactly one explicit furnished room brief and a single floor, optionally resting on one plain supporting slab. No additional rooms, buildings, wings, corridors, courtyards, bridges, towers, landscape or exterior scene. This is a room-scale interior, not a whole architectural structure: spend detail on furniture and surfaces rather than adding 12-28 exterior assemblies. Choose clear interior dimensions roughly 6-9 metres by 5-8 metres and 2.8-3.6 metres high; enlarge the shell to preserve wall and ceiling clearance. Allocate furniture through the dedicated room furnishing pass, not the macro layout. Request 12-18 purposeful furniture and decor components, including at least four functional furniture pieces, with detailed supported small props, plausible dimensions, usable spacing and one appropriate circulation route. Prioritize interior eye-level views, visible furnishings, layered lighting, coherent material finishes and tactile textiles. Every prompt must repeat the exactly-one-room requirement. Across all scenes invent different furniture arrangements, focal points, proportions, styles, palettes and lighting moods; do not vary only colors. Diversity is interior composition and function, not exterior terrain or building silhouette.

categories.Temples & Religious Architecture: One prayer room, meditation chamber, shrine room or sacred study. Vary traditions, ritual furniture, lighting and materials; no temple complex.
categories.Museums & Galleries: One exhibition room with a distinct collection and display layout. Vary exhibit subjects, cases, plinths, seating and lighting; no museum building or multiple galleries.
categories.Showrooms: One product showroom room. Vary product category, display furniture, demonstration area and viewing circulation; no whole retail building.
categories.Minecraft / Voxel Worlds: One furnished voxel-style interior room, such as a crafting room, library, workshop or inn room. Use a single room_shell with block-inspired decoration and furniture; no castles, villages or exterior terrain.
categories.Natural Landscapes & Parks: Interpret as one enclosed nature-inspired room: an indoor garden room, conservatory room, botanical study or park interpretation room. Use plants, natural materials, seating and display furniture; no outdoor landscape, park or separate structures.
categories.Sci-Fi & Futuristic Environments: One furnished futuristic room such as a command room, research room, crew lounge or observation room. Vary technology, function, furniture arrangement and lighting; no spacecraft exterior, city or connected rooms.
